headline: No ISO clears the T1->T2 rubric gate at HEAD — all six read HOLD, unchanged from FF-2D and unchanged after FFR-3A-3 re-measured the T1-H and T1-X halves at the post-FFR-3F HEAD. No ISO clears the §2.1b full-solve authorization gate either. NO DETERMINATION MOVED, but two band-level results did: MISO's retire.total_gw flipped PASS -> FAIL (its 3/3 retirement sweep does not survive the G3 cap-grain fix) and PJM's retirement depth improved 22.415 -> 18.862 GW. Both PJM and MISO now land exactly on the values FFR-2B measured against a paired control. This board is the §2.1b evidence, not a green-wash: every remaining blocker is structural (rule 1).
gate_reading: The dominant T1-F blocker is FC-1 structural — the I4 capacity-accounting leak (the FF-0B "A1" finding, still open) for CAISO/PJM/MISO/NEISO, plus I7 base-year adequacy (A2) for CAISO/MISO/NYISO and ERCOT's I3 scarcity slack. PJM and NEISO are closest — their only T1-F blocker is the single I4 leak invariant; fix A1 and both clear FC-1. The FF-2C capacity-clearing flip is the structurally-correct mechanism and is working; the residuals it exposes are the open retirement-rule / backstop / capacity-accounting lanes, not tuning targets.
readiness: The FF-3E full-horizon readiness battery is GREEN for all six ISOs — the path is bug-free (input-resolution walk, config round-trip, kill-resume drill all clean; wall/RSS projected). Ten hours of compute today would buy a mechanically-clean but structurally-flawed golden run. Compute is not the binding constraint; the T1-F structural blockers are.

All 10 banded metrics reproduce the pre-fix comparator miso-2023-2027-crossover-ffr3a2 to 3 d.p. (delta +0.0000), so MISO joins ERCOT and PJM: all three T1-X legs are unmoved by the G3 cap-grain fix 2adfb49. That is the FFR-3L structural null, now on MISO's OWN evidence (rule 25 clean, nothing imported). NOT an attribution: no control arm ran.
